week.title: Week of {date}
week.formula: ({quality} quality workouts + {rest} credited rest days) ÷ {planned} planned days
week.credited: Goal reached: the week counts towards your streak.
week.notCredited: Goal not reached: the week doesn't count towards the streak.
week.current: This week is still in progress. It joins your consistency score once it ends.

week.notCounted: Not one of the 4 weeks in your current consistency score.

streak.title: Streak
streak.body: A week counts when you reach your weekly goal. A paused week doesn't break the streak.
streak.empty: Your first workout starts your streak.

built.title: How {score} was built
built.body: Week weights: 40%, 30%, 20% and 10%, newest first. Paused weeks are skipped. We count quality workouts and rest days next to a done workout, divided by planned days.
built.empty: Your score appears after your first full week with a plan.

pause.title: Sick or on holiday?

recordsScreen.title: Records
recordsScreen.subtitle: Your personal bests. Strength numbers are estimates.
recordsScreen.emptyBody: Finish a couple of workouts and your personal bests appear here. Your first session sets the baseline.
recordsScreen.emptyFilter: No exercises of this type yet.
recordsScreen.sourceBody: This is an estimate, not a tested max. We use the Brzycki formula (weight × 36 ÷ (37 − reps)) on your best set of 10 reps or fewer.
recordsScreen.sourceNone: No set of 1 to 10 reps with weight yet, so the chart shows your heaviest weight instead.
recordsScreen.setRecordsHint: Heaviest weight for exactly this many reps
recordsScreen.setRecordsEmpty: Log a set of 5, 8 or 10 reps to fill these in.

weight.screenSubtitle: Your trend, not the daily noise
weight.chartHint: Grey dots are weigh-ins, the line is the 7-day average. Daily swings are normal, follow the line.

weight.emptyBody: Enter your weight below. A trend appears after your second weigh-in.
weight.singleBody: Weigh in again to see how it changes.
weight.periodEmptyBody: Pick a longer period or add a weigh-in below.
weight.lockedBody: Free keeps the last 3 months. Premium shows your whole history.

bmiText.under: Your BMI is below the 18.5 mark of the WHO classification.

photoAi.pickHint: We compare an earlier photo with a later one. Tap to change your choice.
